name: AttentionSoftmaxWithSoftcappingAndDropout

y.description: Softmax output with softcapping and dropout applied

reference:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(attn_weights):
    cap = 30.0
    scaled = attn_weights / cap
    clamped = torch.tanh(scaled)
    softcapped = clamped * cap
    softmax_out = F.softmax(softcapped, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).to(attn_weights.dtype)
    return softmax_out
description: Attention softmax with softcapping and dropout. Applies softmax(attn_weights * cap / cap) * cap with optional dropout mask. Pure PyTorch: scaled softmax with tanh-based softcapping.
